title: Will Trump endorse at least 3 people on Truth Social this week?
rules: If Donald Trump endorses at least 3 people for their election on Truth Social from Oct 10, 2026 through Oct 16, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Any formal endorsement will qualify, including reaffirmations of prior endorsements. If Trump endorses multiple people in an election, all will be counted towards the total. The endorsement must be a clear, affirmative statement of support. Ambiguous statements of support will not qualify. Conditional endorsements will qualify. A person cannot be counted more than once in a given week. 

Examples:
Donald Trump states "I endorse [candidate] for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support [candidate]" referencing a political race
Donald Trump states "Vote for [candidate]" publicly
Donald Trump states "[candidate] has my full support" for [race]

Examples that would NOT count:
Trump posts a graphic that says "[Candidate] wins" that merely states as fact they were endorsed by President Trump

blind.reasoning: The week of Oct 10-16, 2026 is about three weeks before the midterms, when Trump usually posts many 'Complete and Total Endorsement' messages on Truth Social. He was doing so as recently as Oct 7 (Tom Tiffany for Wisconsin governor), and in September he endorsed about a dozen governor candidates. Repeat endorsements count and each person in a multi-candidate post counts, so 3 people in 7 days is a low bar.
blind.falsifier: Trump makes fewer than 3 clear endorsements on Truth Social between Oct 10 and Oct 16, 2026, for example because he stops posting due to illness or a crisis, or posts only graphics that don't count.

final.reasoning: The market sits around 0.895, but three weeks before the midterms Trump's Truth Social endorsements make 3 qualifying people in a week near-certain. I trimmed my estimate slightly for resolution risk, yet 0.96 is still above the 0.94 ask.
